title: Closing a gap carries the titles and music after it along
goal: Deleting a piece of a clip slides every caption, title and song after it back with the picture, but closing a gap left by Lift or a dragged-away clip only moves that one track, so a title or a music cue later in the edit ends up over a different moment than the one it was placed on. Make closing a gap move the rest of the edit the same way deleting a piece does, as Premiere does with its default sync lock.
notes: Source: log of done task a-gap-between-clips-closes-with-a-click-and-dele (2026-10-08 04:19): 'only the gap's own track ripples, so titles and music elsewhere stay (Premiere with sync lock off)'; also listed in digest 2026-10-08 under 'What a user will hit'. Piece delete already does the all-tracks version: EditorState+ClipBar.swift deleteClipPieceInHand -> rippleDeleteClipPiece, which uses StretchRemoval.swift. Gap close lives in PhotonzCore TimelineGap.swift (+12 tests) and EditorState+TimelineGap.swift (closeGapInHand). TDD in core: extend TimelineGap tests first. Locked tracks stay put as today. Walks to keep green: a-gap-between-clips-closes-walk, gap-refusal walk (2026-10-08 audit gap-refusal), extract-a-marked-stretch, marquee-and-track-range. No new flag needed if it is a fix to the gap close behaviour; if the runner prefers one, it ships on in Next.
acceptance: On a video at Next defaults: lift 0:04 to 0:08 with I, O and semicolon on a recording that has a title at 0:10 and a music bed on its own track, click the gap, press Delete: the clips after it, the title and the music all move back 4 seconds, in one undo step, and Command Z puts all of them back
A title or song that would land on something already on its own track does not move into it; the close is refused the way a refused close already is, with the notice naming what is in the way
Right-click Ripple Delete on the gap and Shift Delete do exactly what Delete does
A walk covering the title and music case runs green at Next defaults, and the existing gap walks stay green

Audit written under queue/audits/ with a before and after picture of the timeline; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Review before building: Premiere with sync lock on ripples every track when a gap closes, and refuses when another track has something that cannot move. Chosen rule, matching piece delete (StretchRemoval): everything starting at or after the gap end moves; anything starting earlier (music under the take, a title over the gap) stays with its children; locked tracks and locked layers stay put; a collision on any track refuses with the existing pill naming it. Unlike piece delete, nothing is cut or removed: a gap close never deletes a layer.

Built: PhotonzCore TimelineGap.swift closingGap gains carriedAlong(after:except:) (+5 TDD tests, old 'other tracks stay' test replaced). Harness: dragTracks now takes the timeline keyboard as the dock's mouse-down monitor does for a real press; without it a Delete after a canvas click went to the canvas (harness-only gap, the real app was fine). New walk closing-a-gap-carries-the-title-and-music-walk at Next defaults covers Delete, one undo, Shift Delete; Ripple Delete from the right-click menu runs the same closeGap and stays covered by a-gap-between-clips-closes-walk (a new right-click walk would need the Mac to itself). Walks green: new one, a-gap-between-clips-closes, a-gap-is-drawn-as-a-slot, a-gap-that-cannot-close-says-why, marquee-and-track-range, extract-a-marked-stretch. Scripts/test.sh: 11904 tests passed.

Left rough (no task, below the bar): ruler markers do not ripple with a gap close, same as piece delete today; the 2026-10-08 gap-refusal audit's line that only a caption is ever named in the way is now out of date, since a song can be.

Closing a gap (Delete, Shift Delete, right-click Ripple Delete) now moves everything after it on every track back by its length, titles and music included, in one undo step; things starting before the gap end and locked tracks/layers stay put; a collision refuses with the pill naming it. PhotonzCore TimelineGap.swift (+5 tests), walk closing-a-gap-carries-the-title-and-music-walk green at Next defaults with the existing gap walks, suite 11904 green, audit 2026-10-08-gap-close-sync.
